// Positive control for [NS-33-R11] (BL-1841): a PictureCard whose prop is off on one image and missing on the other.
import { Image } from 'react-native';
import { Image as ExpoPic } from 'expo-image';
export const PictureCard = ({ uri }: { uri: string }) => (
  <>
    <Image source={{ uri }} accessibilityIgnoresInvertColors={false} />
    <ExpoPic source={uri} />
  </>
);
